source.grain: named pickup zone / NYC local calendar day
source.target: observed yellow-taxi pickup records; not unmet or total transport demand
source.duplicate_policy: source records counted; no assumed unique trip key or deduplication
source.coverage_rule: all declared files parse and every calendar day has accepted records
source.coverage_limit: checks do not prove complete vendor submissions
source.time_zone: TLC NYC local timestamps; daily buckets retain 23/25-hour DST days

capacity_scenario.basis: mean daily accepted pickups in final 28 pre-calibration days
capacity_scenario.status: illustrative allocation simulation; not vehicles, dispatch or measured savings

evaluation.rolling_origin: one-day-ahead replay; features updated daily, parameters frozen before calibration
evaluation.availability_assumption: previous-day pickup totals assumed available; monthly public TLC publication cannot supply this live
evaluation.interval_limit: per-zone absolute residual quantiles; temporal dependence/shift means no guaranteed future coverage
evaluation.selection_rule: lowest selection-month MAE, baseline on ties; no final-test tuning

code.note: module hash includes uncommitted source bytes; base revision alone is not build identity
